businessName: Global Fitness (Aerofit Treadmills & Gym Equipment Store)
whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Global Fitness,

I noticed your fitness equipment store has exceptional 4.9★ reviews from over 1,000 customers in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for home gym and treadmill inquiries.

Maine aapke store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp product inquiry, premium cardio/strength equipment showcase, aur Kankarbagh location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/aerofit

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Global Fitness, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke fitness store ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp product inquiries, a premium equipment showcase, and your Kankarbagh location directions. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact inventory, actual store photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
